claims.claim_text: Support for options for learning, including home schooling and local innovations like single-sex classes, full-day school hours, and year-round schools.

Support for school choice—whether through charter schools, open enrollment requests, college lab schools, virtual schools, career and technical education programs, vouchers, or tax credits—as important for all children, especially for families with children in failing schools.
Getting youngsters into decent learning environments and helping them to realize their full potential is the greatest civil rights challenge.
Support for the promotion of local career and technical educational programs and entrepreneurial programs supported by leaders in industry.
Support for retraining and retooling the American workforce.
A young person's ability to achieve in school must be based on talent and motivation, not address, zip code, or economic status.
